(Check: f(11) = (33 + 7)/(11 - 3) = 5.) The value -4 comes from a sign error when isolating x, which gives a = -3 and f(5) = (-15 + 7)/2. The value 21 comes from taking a equal to the constant 7 in the numerator: (35 + 7)/2 = 21. The value -14 comes from taking a = -7: (-35 + 7)/2 = -14.
